description: Bitter yellow root bark. A day and a night of being shown your own life, and a heart that may not agree to it.

effects.comeon_message: It's so bitter you gag. Your pulse speeds up, then skips.

events.text: [trip]A dry buzzing takes you over, head to foot, and won't be shaken off.[/trip]
[trip]It begins at the beginning, which you didn't expect and can't look away from.[/trip]
[trip]You're shown something you did and the room waits for you to say something about it.[/trip]
[trip]A long, patient accounting. Nobody here is angry with you, and nobody looks away.[/trip]
[trip]Your heart does something irregular and the visions don't pause for it.[/trip]
[trip]It finishes. It doesn't offer a conclusion. You're simply let go.[/trip]

effects.onset_message: Your whole body buzzes. Then you start remembering your life, in order, whether you want to or not.

overdose.message: Your heartbeat goes wrong, stays wrong, and stops.

phases.comedown_message: The memories stop in the middle of one and don't start again.
phases.end_message: It's been a day and a night. You haven't moved, and your chest aches.

effects.take_line: You chew the bitter {name} bark down and swallow.

withdrawal.message: You feel like you're waiting for an answer. It's not coming.

stages.easing: You stop trying to get it back.
stages.onset: Whatever it was showing you starts to slip away.
stages.peak: It showed you your whole life and then stopped, and you can't go back to check what you saw.
stages.rising: You keep waiting for it to finish. It already has.
stages.tail: You'll never know if what it showed you was true.

name: ibogaine
